Conclusion: Qualified partial support; use six Holm-adjusted tests above. Nonsignificant controls do not establish no effect.

Question: H2: model framing
Conclusion: Recorded label differences and paired-TV coordination are distinct evidence. Preserve model pairing; joint exchangeability across configurations remains an assumption.

Question: H3: category ordering
Conclusion: Raw ordering present; the direct AR-minus-AI contrast is not robust to the conditional-null reference. Report both estimands.

Question: H4: magnitude
Conclusion: The common-model gap remains positive after three-vote standardization. This is an empirical difference, not an isolated intrinsic-sensitivity effect.

Question: H4: direction
Conclusion: Small conditional average-delta alignment. Averaging personas before cosine can cancel effects; do not equate it with persona-specific alignment.

Question: Prompt comparisons
Conclusion: Exploratory TV analysis; no rejection is not prompt equivalence or a statement about accuracy.

Question: Vector added value
Conclusion: Distinguishes redistribution, changes in observed emotion support, tie changes, direction and size. All-valid and common-model figures retain their own denominators.
